Placeholder for an unset optional prop

Source: R/utils.R
dot-el_or_na.Rd

A field left out of the Vue instance's data is not reactive, so update_el_*() can never set it later. Unset optional props are therefore declared as NA, which serialises to null, and read back through .el_optional_bind(), which turns that null into undefined so Element applies its own default.

Usage

.el_or_na(x)

Arguments

x

A value, or NULL when the user did not supply one.

Value

x, or NA when x is NULL.
